about: Employer job postings for the nightly browser liveness check (scripts/liveness.mjs). Maintained from the repo owner's job tracker: postings whose employer page cannot be read without a browser. Targets whose id starts with calib- are known-closed controls: if one ever reads live, that night's live results are not trustworthy. Boards are employer careers pages that only list their jobs in a browser; the check records the job links they show, for discovery only.
